items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about the so-called piano school of Harlem, people like Willie the Lion and Fats Waller and Albert Ammons?

ctx.x: Glenn Miller made the tune popular. That's Joe Garland's tune and Joe Garland is collecting the money and Joe Garland has got money like this and as long as he lives it's going to keep coming in every time he plays the record.
What about the so-called piano school of Harlem, people like Willie the Lion and Fats Waller and Albert Ammons?
